payload.summary: Planned Phase 2 after consolidate-model-tier-sources. Gate 1 selected Approach A: skills author archetype/tier vocabulary from archetypes.yaml; harnesses still receive resolved model ids. CI hardens test_skill_model_hints to ban string literals; cite-requirements dual-resolves economy tiers.

decisions.title: Approach A — authored vocabulary vs dispatch payload
decisions.rationale: Harnesses need concrete model ids; skills must not author raw versions as policy. Resolve at dispatch from YAML.

decisions.title: Harden test_skill_model_hints in place
decisions.rationale: Reuse existing CI hook; empty opus/sonnet/haiku allowlist; extend Agent/-m checks.

decisions.title: cite-requirements dual economy-tier resolve
decisions.rationale: Keep dual-vendor diversity without hardcoded haiku/luna pins.

decisions.title: Stay off archetypes.yaml / adaptive router
decisions.rationale: Coexist with concurrent roster and routing proposals.

decisions.title: Tier coordinated; sequential wp-main
decisions.rationale: Coordinator available; small shared skill/CI surface prefers one sequential package.
